shnook.e: Don't be such an apologetic shnook.
shnook.m: (Yiddish) a gullible simpleton more to be pitied than despised.

shnooks.e: Don't be such an apologetic shnook.

shnorrer.m: (Yiddish) a scrounger who takes advantage of the generosity of others.
